# DEMO / TEST FIXTURE DATA — DO NOT USE FOR ANALYSIS

Everything in this folder is either synthetic or a tiny illustrative subset
created **only** to let the ingestion/preprocessing pipeline and its automated
tests run without requiring a multi-GB real download first. Per the project's
"no fake results" rule, none of this is ever wired into the main analytical
pipeline by default, and it must never be the source of a real skill-gap,
alignment, or demand number.

| File | What it is | Why it's not real |
|---|---|---|
| `sample_curriculum.pdf` | A 3-page PDF generated by `generate_fixture_pdf.py` (reportlab), styled like a CS programme handbook (course codes, units, topics, outcomes). | Entirely made up — "Demo University" does not exist. Used to test PDF text extraction + structuring logic (`ingest_curriculum.py`). |
| `job_postings_fixture.csv` | 12 short job-posting-like rows covering the cases the preprocessing pipeline must handle: a clean posting, an exact duplicate, a near-duplicate (reworded), an empty description, an HTML-laden description, a too-short description, and a few valid postings with different tech stacks. | Hand-written, not scraped from anywhere. Used to unit/integration-test validation, cleaning, and deduplication against a known, hand-verified expected outcome. |
| `esco_skills_fixture.csv` | 8 rows, structurally modeled on the real ESCO CSV schema (`conceptUri`, `preferredLabel`, `altLabels`, `description`). | A handful of illustrative rows, not a full or authoritative ESCO extract — used to test the ESCO CSV parser without needing the full multi-thousand-row official download. |
| `onet_technology_skills_fixture.txt` | 6 rows, structurally modeled on the real O*NET "Technology Skills.txt" schema. | Same rationale as above, for the O*NET parser. |

To run the real analytical pipeline, follow `docs/data_sources.md` to download
the actual ESCO/O*NET/job-postings data and real university curricula, and
point the ingestion scripts at `data/raw/...` instead of this folder.
| `core_knowledge_fixture.csv` / `.json` | Synthetic core-knowledge records (all names prefixed `FIXTURE`), including one intentionally invalid row each. | Invented for loader/validation tests. Ingest only with `--test-data` so `DataSource.is_test_data=1`. Never real academic knowledge. |
